list.title: Parents
list.description: Manage parent accounts that can sign in.
list.search: Search by surname, nickname or email...
list.emptySearchHint: Try another surname, nickname or email.
list.emptyHint: Create the first account to give a parent access.

status.deactivateBody: The account will be deactivated (reversible). The parent will no longer be able to sign in.
status.reactivateBody: The account will become usable again.
status.confirmBody: {name} will no longer be able to sign in (reversible from their record).

form.newHint: Credentials are emailed as soon as the account is created. At least one child must be assigned.
form.passwordHint: 8 characters minimum · 1 capital letter · 1 digit — emailed to the parent.
form.noRights: Insufficient permissions — you may not create a parent account.
form.childRequired: At least one child must be assigned.

multiselect.search: Search for a child by surname, first names or ID...

resetHintParent: The new password is emailed to the parent — they do not have to set it again.

invite.confirmNever: This parent has never signed in. They will receive the welcome email again, at the same address, with a NEW password — the original cannot be recovered, as the platform only keeps a hashed fingerprint of it.
invite.confirmUsed: ⚠️ This parent has already signed in, so they may have chosen their own password. Resending will replace it with a new one, and the old password will stop working. Only continue if they told you they can no longer sign in.
invite.sent: Invitation resent. The parent will receive a new password by email.
